structured_output.rationale: 835 shows CO-16 on all three lines with claim-level MOA N286 (missing/invalid referring provider). Claim billed to Medicare Part B (MB) with rendering provider Lopez but no referring/ordering provider in the 837P. Patient is eligible (271 EB*1, active since 2024-01-01). Fix: add valid ordering/referring NPI and resubmit as new original (CLM05-3=1) per Part B rules.

root_cause.explanation: Claim denied CO-16 + N286 at claim level. The 837P contains no ordering/referring provider loop. Medicare requires a valid referring NPI for therapy services.

next_action.detail: Add the ordering/referring provider NPI (verify in PECOS) and resubmit as a new original claim (CLM05-3=1). Do not use frequency 7 on Part B.

evidence.fact: CAS*CO*16 on all three lines; MOA***N286 at claim level — missing/invalid referring provider identifier
No referring/ordering provider NM1 segment (loop 2310A) present in the claim
EB*1*IND*30 — patient active Medicare Part B on DOS 2026-01-22
CO-16+N286: correct and resubmit as CLM05-3=1 on Medicare Part B; do not appeal a data defect

citations.rule: CO-16+N286 = missing referring provider; correct_and_resubmit as new original on Part B
Part B does not accept frequency 7; resubmit as CLM05-3=1
